interface.title: StarPlot | Gaia DR3 H–R Diagram
interface.field: Astronomy: stellar astrophysics and star clusters
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring data and making figures for teaching or presentation
interface.what_it_is_for: Pick named star groups (the solar neighbourhood, open clusters, globular clusters), pull their Gaia DR3 photometry with a live query, and plot colour index against absolute magnitude on a Hertzsprung–Russell diagram you can zoom, pan, colour by theme and export as a poster.

data.source: public: the ESA Gaia DR3 archive, queried live over TAP (the tool ships no data of its own)
data.note: The tool sends live ADQL queries to the ESA Gaia TAP server at https://gea.esac.esa.int/tap-server/tap/sync, which the sandbox blocks. In the exploring run, the queries that finished ended with the banner '⚠️ Network error querying Gaia TAP … Failed to fetch' and 'Plotted 0 stars across N sources' (screens/016.webp, 020.webp, 024.webp). In the replay, the fetch never finished at all: after several minutes and a reload, the 'Fetching Gaia DR3 photometry...' badge was still showing. No stars were ever plotted. The only thing on the chart was the reference grid: spectral-class letters B–M along the top, region labels (Red Giants, Main Sequence, White Dwarfs) and a fixed Sun marker.

children.general: Export the current figure as a high-resolution image
children.specific: Press 'Export Print Poster (PNG)'. The download is named starplot-hr-poster-<targets>-<theme>.png, where <targets> holds only the first three selected target ids and <theme> is the internal theme id, not the menu name (Aurora Borealis → 'emerald'). Per the source code (App.tsx:450-478, read by the reviewer, not seen in the run), the poster renders the current zoom bounds at 3000×2100 with a poster title and subtitle.

features.name: Grouped multi-select preset chips with a combined live query
features.general: Pick any mix of named sample sets from category rows, with select-all and select-none. The selection is summarised in a header and a counter, and the chosen sets are fetched from a remote archive together, with loading, empty and error states.
features.specific: In the Stellar Groups & Messier Catalog panel, toggle Solar Volume, Open Cluster and Globular Cluster chips ('+' to add, '✓' to remove). The 'N / 16 selected' counter and the subtitle (in catalog order) update, and a Gaia TAP query runs for the union. Status reads 'Fetching ESA Gaia TAP (…)…', then either 'Plotted N stars across M sources' (only N = 0 was ever seen) or a red network-error banner; in the replay the fetch never ended. With nothing selected the canvas shows an empty-state prompt and 'Plotted 0 stars across 0 sources'.
steps: Click a '+' chip to add a target (or 'Select All')
Click a '✓' chip to remove it (or 'Select None' for the empty-state prompt)
Watch the subtitle and counter list the current selection
Wait for the fetch badge to end in a plotted count or an error banner
serves_tasks: Start with a nearby field-star sample, the reference for the main sequence and the white-dwarf sequence
Add a young open cluster beside the field sample
Plot an old open cluster on its own
Select old, metal-poor globular clusters, to look for their red giant branch and subgiants
Overlay every available population for a survey view, leaving out any you don't want

features.name: Zoomable, pannable scatter canvas with reset
features.general: Explore a dense scatter plot by zooming with the wheel or buttons and panning by drag. The axes re-tick as you go, and a reset control appears only while the view differs from the default.
features.specific: On the H–R canvas (G_BP − G_RP colour index against M_G absolute magnitude, with spectral-class letters along the top), scroll to zoom, use '＋ Zoom In' / '－ Zoom Out', drag to pan, and press '↺ Reset View' to return to the full −0.5–4.0 by −4 to +20 range. Checked on the empty reference grid only.
steps: Scroll over the chart or press '＋ Zoom In'
Press '↺ Reset View' to restore the default extent
serves_tasks: Zoom into a region of the plot and return to the full view

features.name: Themed plot with themed print export
features.general: Restyle a chart with a palette picker, including a light print palette, then export the current view as a high-resolution PNG whose file name records part of the content and the palette.
features.specific: Pick one of five themes in the Color Scheme dropdown (Planck Blackbody, Cosmic Ultraviolet, Aurora Borealis, JWST Infrared Gold, Archival Print (Light)). The canvas, axis and spectral-class colours change; the choice resets on reload. 'Export Print Poster (PNG)' then downloads starplot-hr-poster-<first three target ids>-<internal theme id>.png (e.g. 'emerald' for Aurora Borealis). Per the source (App.tsx:450-478), the poster renders the current zoom bounds at 3000×2100 with a title and subtitle; the run could not open the image to confirm this.
steps: Choose a theme from the Color Scheme dropdown
Find the downloaded PNG, named after the first selected targets and the theme id
serves_tasks: Switch the colour scheme of the plot
Export the current figure as a high-resolution image
